name: Chat Stress
description: Seeds two deterministic conversations (600 and 20 messages of long paragraphs, Markdown lists and code blocks), opens a chat view, then switches between the large and the small conversation. Measures from the selection to the first page of messages in the store, then until rendering goes quiet.
initialConditions: Fresh disposable profile, 1280x840 window, workspace shown, side panel closed, Research layout, one chat view. Fixture: seed 7, chats 'Lab Big' (600 messages) and 'Lab Small' (20 messages), generated by UiLab::fixtureMessage.

methods.seedChats: fixture: UiLab.seedChats writes the conversations to the test profile's database
methods.refreshChats: store-call: ChatStore.refresh (what the app does on start)
methods.selectChat: store-call: ChatStore.selectChat (what picking a conversation in the side panel does)
